'''Robonino''' was a [[Patrolian/Legends|Patrolian]], a diminutive and brightly [[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] with fish-like features who wore an [[Eye patch/Legends|eye patch]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He teamed up with [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]], and [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] during the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]].

==Biography==
During the war, Robonino teamed up with [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], but their ship fell apart and they were found by the [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|Black Hole Pirates]]. Robonino and Bossk then joined up with the pirates. While Bossk found himself an outcast in the gang, Robonino became a respected hacker and earned himself a place on the team.

[[File:Robonino_shocking_Skywalker.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Robonino defeating Anakin Skywalker with an incapacitating electric shock]]
Robonino was later included in a mission organized by [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to see how "solitary types" like himself, [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]], and [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] would work together. The set mission to capture [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Davtokk]] on the planet [[Keyorin]]; Davtokk attempted to take out Bane to collect the bounty on his head, but was relatively easily overcome by Bane's team.<ref name="Invitation Only">''[[The Clone Wars: Invitation Only]]''</ref> Pleased with their performance, Bane moved the team to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to prepare for an operation to liberate [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] incarceration.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

During the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]], Robonino [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] the power distribution network of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] from the [[Power control room/Legends|control room]]. He triggered the emergency lock-down in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]], which allowed Bane to execute the rest of his plan. Robonino was also able to single-handedly defeat [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] by grabbing him from behind and electrocuting him while the Jedi fought Shahan Alama and Aurra Sing. After the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] was freed, Robonino left the crime scene along with the rest of the group.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />
[[File:SpeederChase-POP.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Robonino pursues Senator Amidala through the skyways of Coruscant]]
Once he left, Robonino later ended up on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], where he had modified leftover [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to cover his path and hide his [[Robonino's hideout|hideout]], which was an underwater hub. Due to this, it caused the local wildlife to die, giving reason for Senator [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] to summon [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] to sort out the situation. In the ensuing [[Skirmish on Rodia|skirmish]], Robonino briefly battled and defeated Fisto, but was apparently swallowed by a [[Kwazel Maw/Legends|Kwazel Maw]]. He was later regurgitated, alive and well, on shore where Fisto, Farr, and surviving clone troopers were waiting for him.

He later escaped, allowing him to be hired by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] along with [[Chata Hyoki/Legends|another hired gun]] to persuade senators to change their minds about a bill that would appropriate funds for millions of new clone troops. They targeted many senators whose vote was to oppose the bill, which brought the bill a greater chance of being approved. In a bar at Coruscant, Count Dooku would again send the two bounty hunters to seize [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] to prevent her from influencing other senators' thoughts. However, they missed the primary target, and attacked Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] instead. Nonetheless, the scheme failed, and they were subsequently arrested, with the senator from Naboo still possessing the chance to turn the tide against the bill.

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Patsfan-01.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Robonino's backpack says "PATSFAN-01" in Aurebesh]]
Robonino was an expert saboteur, and skilled at handling explosives, allowing him to battle [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] such as Anakin Skywalker and Kit Fisto and come out victorious.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Robonino's look was based on an unused prequel Jedi design by [[Iain McCaig]]. He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode022.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hostage Crisis}}</ref>

The text on Robonino's backpack reads "PATSFAN-01" in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide" />
